safe_exit_followup.local_gap: Closed: world desktop exit uses the retail question, affirmative callback, save path and title. Original Quit Game remains separate; title desktop exit remains immediate.
safe_exit_followup.upstream_cancellation_risk: Addressed by tagging the original cloned functor and arming only on its affirmative invocation, including across threads.
safe_exit_followup.candidate: Implemented and verified: synchronous factory tag follows both original clone functions; callback BN 0x200d050 arms desktop exit before its preserved state write at 0x200d0c4.
safe_exit_followup.remaining: Broader full-port/region acceptance remains separate; no claim of every possible save I/O failure scenario.
